newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ's Brash to speak at Pukekohe on Friday.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ's Brash to speak at Pukekohe on Friday.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) said on Wednesday its governor Don Brash would give an on-the-record speech on Friday at Pukekohe.
The gathering is the AGM of the Counties Kiwifruit Growers Association.
Brash is expected to begin his address about 4.45 p.m., but copies of his speech will be sent to the media in advance with an embargo until 4.00 p.m. (0400 GMT).
